question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH la_males AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.full_name,
        MIN(t.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms t ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND t.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.full_name
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        full_name,
        first_term_start,
        gs AS years_elapsed,
        CAST(SUBSTR(first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + gs AS check_year
    FROM la_males
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(31, 49)) AS gs)
),
active_check AS (
    SELECT 
        y.id_bioguide,
        y.years_elapsed,
        y.check_year,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t 
            WHERE t.id_bioguide = y.id_bioguide 
            AND t.term_start <= CAST(y.check_year || '-12-31' AS VARCHAR)
            AND t.term_end >= CAST(y.check_year || '-12-31' AS VARCHAR)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_active
    FROM years_to_check y
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(31, 49)) AS years_elapsed
)
SELECT 
    ay.years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ac.is_active = 1 THEN ac.id_bioguide END) as distinct_legislators_active
FROM all_years ay
LEFT JOIN active_check ac ON ay.years_elapsed = ac.years_elapsed
GROUP BY ay.years_elapsed
ORDER BY ay.years_elapsed
